question: Who among the following rulers appointed Ladha and Pira, two gardeners to high administrative post?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Muhammad Tughluq.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Muhammad Tughluq **appointed Ladha and Pira, two gardeners to high administrative posts.
 
• Sultan Muhammad Tughluq appointed:
 
 
• Aziz Khummar, a wine distiller,
 
• Firuz Hajjam, a barber,
 
• Manka Tabbakh, a cook, and
 
• Two gardeners, Ladha and Pira, to high administrative posts.
 
 
 
• **Ziyauddin Barani,** a mid-fourteenth-century chronicler, reported their appointments as a sign of Sultan’s loss of political judgment and his incapacity to rule.
 
• **Barani **had criticized Muhammad Tughluq for that appointment.
 
• **Tughluq's** appointment reflected the socio-economic stereotypes that may have been prevalent in those times.
 
• The authors of **Persian tawarikh **criticized the Delhi Sultans for appointing the “low and base-born” to high offices.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Khizr Khan** was the founder of the Sayyid dynasty of the **Delhi Sultanate**.

 
 
• In 1414 AD, Khizr Khan occupied the power of Delhi.
 
• He did not hold the title of Sultan and declared himself as **‘Rayat-e-Ala’.**
 
• He was the founder of the Sayyid Dynasty in India and ruled as a deputy of Timur’s son and successor, Shah Rukh.
 
• His reign was marked by utter chaos and disorder.
 
 
 
• The Lodi dynasty was founded by** Bahlul Khan Lodi**.
 
 
• The Lodi dynasty was an Afghan dynasty.
 
• The Lodi dynasty was the last dynasty in Delhi Sultanate, ruled from 1451 to 1526.
 
 
 
• ​Iltutmish was a king of the Slave dynasty.
 
 
• He became a ruler of the Slave dynasty from 1211 to 1236.
 
• He made Delhi the capital of his kingdom by replacing Lahore.
 
• He introduced the silver coin(Tanka) and the copper coin(Jital).
 
• He completed the construction of the Qutb Minar.
